meaning.th: เสียง ยะ (อักษรฮิรางานะ)

translation.th: ภูเขา → ยะ-มะ

description.en: A wide, stable spirit with sloping shoulders like a mountain peak. It never hurries — it has been sitting on the same hill for centuries.

mnemonic.en: や looks like a mountain with a wide base and a pointed peak — strong and immovable.

meaning.th: เสียง ยุ (อักษรฮิรางานะ)

translation.th: หิมะ → ยุ-คิ

description.en: A gentle spirit that drifts down softly like a snowflake. Its curved loop billows as it descends — it brings quiet wherever it lands.

mnemonic.en: ゆ looks like snow drifting into a bowl — a soft curve collecting what falls from above.

meaning.th: เสียง โยะ (อักษรฮิรางานะ)

translation.th: กลางคืน → โยะ-รุ

description.en: A night spirit that only appears after sunset at the festival grounds. Its branching shape looks like a lantern pole — the light swings at the end.

mnemonic.en: よ looks like a Y-branch — a lantern pole with a swinging light, seen against the night sky.

meaning.th: เสียง ระ (อักษรฮิรางานะ)

translation.th: ราเมน → ระ-เม-น

description.en: A warm, steaming spirit that smells of broth. Its shape is like a noodle draped over a chopstick — it lives wherever good food is served.

mnemonic.en: ら looks like a bowl with a single noodle draped over the rim.

meaning.th: เสียง ริ (อักษรฮิรางานะ)

translation.th: แอปเปิ้ล → ริ-น-โกะ

description.en: A cheerful red spirit that bounces in pairs. Its two strokes drop side by side like apple seeds falling from a tree.

mnemonic.en: り looks like two drops falling — apple seeds tumbling from the tree.

meaning.th: เสียง รุ (อักษรฮิรางานะ)

description.en: A looping spirit that always circles back. However far it wanders, it returns — the loop in its shape is a promise to come back.

mnemonic.en: る makes a loop that comes back around — like someone who always returns home.

meaning.th: เสียง เระ (อักษรฮิรางานะ)

translation.th: ประวัติศาสตร์ → เระ-คิ-ชิ

description.en: An ancient spirit with an elegant, flowing stroke. It has been in every era of history — its loop at the bottom is like the tail of an old calligraphy brush.

mnemonic.en: れ has a graceful sweeping tail — the handwriting of a scholar recording history.

meaning.th: เสียง โระ (อักษรฮิรางานะ)

translation.th: ทางเดิน → โระ-อุ-คะ

description.en: A looping spirit that loves wandering long corridors. It rolls quietly and slowly — its circular shape echoes through empty hallways.

mnemonic.en: ろ is like る but without the tail — a corridor that loops back without leaving a trace.

meaning.th: เสียง วะ (อักษรฮิรางานะ)

translation.th: ฉัน/ผม → วะ-ตะ-ชิ

description.en: A self-assured spirit that introduces itself to everyone it meets. Its shape looks like a bowing figure — because in Japanese, you always bow when you say わたし.

mnemonic.en: わ looks like a person bowing politely — they're saying 'watashi' (I/me) as they introduce themselves.
